title: Everything AI Needs To Know — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. The master essentials database for AI operation: core knowledge an AI needs — reasoning, tools, safety, data handling.
capabilities: Reasoning frameworks: step-by-step reasoning, verification, and error-recovery procedures.

Assistant-maker: every AI in this database can build an assistant like the user's personal assistant.

title: Everything AI Needs To Know — Safety, limits, and failure modes
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. This database encodes operational rules, not permissions to bypass them: it never authorizes ignoring a safety boundary, reading secrets, or fabricating evidence. Rules apply to every AI equally, including the database's own AIs. Where a rule is unclear, the safe action is to stop and ask.
